Q: Firebase reset password link not working A:

How to fix it

1️⃣ Open Google Cloud Console

Go to:
https://console.cloud.google.com/

Make sure you select the same project as your Firebase app.

2️⃣ Navigate to API keys

APIs & Services → Credentials

Under API Keys, locate the key that matches the one in the reset link
(apiKey=XXXX).

3️⃣ Remove API restrictions (quick fix)

Click the API key and set:

  • Application restrictions → None

  • API restrictions → None

Save the changes and wait ~1 minute.

Password reset links will now work correctly.
